text_block_list.text:
The day of the Spring Fan Thanksgiving.
Various events are held to express gratitude to the fans who support them day in and day out.

Ikuno Dictus was also planning
a race experience booth, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: The track is full of holes, you say?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. The morning relay race got so intense...
that the track is completely torn up.
choice_data_list: Making the fans run might be a little dangerous, though...
Might be a little dangerous to make the fans run...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's move on to another plan.
We'll set up the interactive booth in a different way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Is there anything I can help with?
I'll gladly lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do!
The New Race Experience Booth... or rather,
'Plan G' is now underway!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First is announcing the changes to the content.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Helios & Ikuno
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, YAYYYY☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That will do. Could you please attach the photo we just took and spread the word?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okie-dokie~!
Imma make this go totally viral for now!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, impressive as expected of someone with 60,000 followers.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, although this is sudden,
we would like you to participate in
an exhibition race.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I see... I understand the situation.
If you don't mind me, I would be glad to help.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Wait, aren't you hosting a race trial corner? Is it really okay for me to run in it?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I have an idea.
I am certain it will be something the fans will thoroughly enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"You are one of the right people for the job.
I look forward to working with you."

Even after that, Ikuno Dictus continued
to reach out to the students—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Now all the participants are gathered.
All that's left is 'that.'"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the VR Umalator had a detachable camera, right?
Just as Ikuno Dictus says, there should have been several ultra-compact cameras installed inside the VR Umalator, but...
choice_data_list: (But, what on earth are they going to use that for...?)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With a borrowed camera, "Plan G" is all set to go.
Allow me to show you a whole new kind of racing experience!
And so, thanks to Ikuno Dictus's adept skills, preparations for the mock race event were finished in no time.

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Fans
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what this 'whole new racing experience' is like!"
"No idea~. I can't wait for it to start!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: YO, YO! Thanks for waiting! Mic check, one, two!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyoone!!
Are you ready for a brand new sensation!?

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's finally starting...!"
"Man, my heart is pounding...!"
choice_data_list: What the hell is about to start?
What on earth is about to start?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪
Alright, eyes on your smartphones, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Check out the link I mass-DMed, 'kay? ☆
The link led to video footage of Ikuno Dictus and the others, seemingly livestreaming from the racecourse below.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to a whole new race experience.
Take a look at the footage—do you notice anything right away?

At first glance, it's ordinary footage. But every now and then,
it shakes subtly, or suddenly points toward the ground—its instability is concerning.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you understand now?
The correct answer is—like this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Actually, what you were just watching was from my perspective—Zenno Rob Roy's.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So right now, it's Ikuno-san's POV!
Of course, you can also enjoy Royce-chan's POV☆

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, the realism is insane!"
"What is even happening...!?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is real-time footage
from the miniature camera mounted on my glasses.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you tap the Umamusume's name on the screen,
you can switch between them on that side as well.

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's true!"
"I really feel like an Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Through the cameras, everyone will be able to enjoy our speed more vividly and more dynamically.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival Special Race, "Plan G"—
we are now holding the "Glasses Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Fans
text_block_list.text: "Whoaaaーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible crowd.
Heh, even if it's just an exhibition, I refuse to lose.

The Umamusume head toward the starting gates.
With every step, my vision sways.
Excited breaths can be heard from all around.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Answering their cheers with a furious late charge at the very end...
This storyline... I will make it a reality!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even under the public eye, I won't waver...!
All to take another step toward becoming a hero...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fifty meters straight ahead, the inner turf is chewed up.
If I jump out and look for an opening...
No, I'd just get boxed in at best.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, we simply push past it.
Force our way through with pure power...!"

Blinded by the glaring backlight, Ikuno Dictus
refuses to avert her eyes.
Fixing her gaze straight ahead, locked solely on the goal beyond—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahâ!!!!

A thunderous gallop tearing into the ground!
Immediately breaking past speeds of 50 km/h!
The scenery, the entire world, is left far behind!

Everyone was left speechless, having experienced
something they would never forget...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Everyone seemed to leave satisfied.
choice_data_list: That really was an amazing event...!
That really was an amazing event...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However, failing to open the intended race experience booth is something we must reflect upon.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to prevent the trouble beforehand,
so I'll conduct today's analysis and review.
Impressed by her stoic nature, I made sure to first praise her for today's hard work!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

After the race, unable to sit still,
I rushed out to where Ikuno Dictus was.
choice_data_list: So this is the kind of world you've been running in!
So this is the kind of world you've been running in!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is our tension and our speed.
I would be glad if you were able to experience even a glimpse of it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It was a blessing in disguise, but I'm glad it all worked out.

Words like that don't do it justice.
The emotion of experiencing your own student's running
surpasses anything else...!
choice_data_list: Will you show me again someday?
Will you show me again someday?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Pardon? That's fine with me, though.
choice_data_list: I want to know more about your world.
I want to know more about your world

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please take a good, long look.
Feel free to experience it as many times as you like.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I would like you to know more about me as well.
choice_data_list: Of course, that's what I intend to do!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's far more than just a blessing in disguise.
Fufufu... It's a tremendous success.
